facts.fact: In February 2022, 58.3% of CMOs said their companies had created stronger data strategies to capture better information, per an eMarketer source cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: In February 2022, [58.3% of CMOs](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/cmos-focus-less-gathering-data-cookieless-future) said their companies had created stronger data strategies

facts.fact: By September 2024, the share of CMOs saying their companies had created stronger data strategies to capture better information dropped to 41.9%, per an eMarketer source cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: yet by September 2024, that number dropped to just 41.9%.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes contextual AI targeting as analyzing on-page content and user engagement to predict intent, without following users across the web or needing personal identifiers.
facts.quote: Instead of following users across the web, AI will analyze on-page content and user engagement to predict intent.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that success with 1st-party data in AI advertising depends on three things: capturing high-quality data through trusted channels, applying AI to segment and activate that data, and staying compliant with evolving privacy laws.
facts.quote: Success in this new landscape depends on three things: capturing high-quality data through trusted channels
